correctness.rationale: For unlike adjacent colors AB, mutual strict utility improvement is equivalent to exterior colors BA; equivalently the four cyclic entries alternate. Stability therefore forbids adjacent singleton monochromatic runs. For 2r runs, at most r are singletons and hence n>=3r; equality forces alternating run lengths 1,2 and composition {r,2r}. The explicit cyclic run-length construction attains every feasible r, with precisely the n=3r balanced obstruction. Every monochromatic edge contributes one to welfare, giving W=n-2r and exact LPoA (n-2)/(n-2r*), including n=3.
risks: Only adjacent mutually strictly beneficial swaps, full occupancy, and two types; nonlocal/stochastic models not covered.
